truthReference: Independent hand audit of validation/m12/fixtures/css/*.css against CSS semantics and the M11 CSS contract (validated 1.000/1.000 in M11.12). Symbols: each rule selector becomes a class/type/interface symbol named by its full resolved selector text (e.g. `.card .title`, `#orders-table th, #orders-table td`), with kind by specificity composition: bare `#id` -> interface, bare tag -> type, `.class` -> class, everything else (pseudo/attribute/complex/descendant) -> class; `--custom-property` declarations -> variable symbols; `@keyframes` names -> function symbols; `@layer`/`@container`/`@mixin` at-rules -> module/function symbols; `@supports` -> interface symbol. Structural noise that is NOT a symbol: universal reset rules (`*`, `*::before`, `*::after`), `@media` queries (structural scope only), keyframe `from`/`to` blocks. Relationships: the production pipeline (filterNoiseRelationships, M11 port d7b5015) deliberately narrows CSS to `contains` only as a hyphenated-property noise guard — verified contract here is `contains` (custom-property scope `:root contains --primary`; at-rule scope `@layer base contains body`; media scope `@media (...) contains .header`; nested-selector scope `.nav contains .nav .item`; selector-chain scoping `.card contains .title` / `#orders-table contains th` where the chain source/target are the selector parts as they appear in symbols). The analyzer additionally emits `uses` (selector -> property), `references` (var() -> --var), animation refs and `@include` mixin refs — verified via direct analyzer probe but intentionally filtered from production storage for CSS, documented in the analyzer doc.
note: M12 per-analyzer differential for css. Precision/recall/fp/fn/unknown computed against independent ground truth. Identity contract: symbol facts keyed by file:line:kind:name; relationship facts keyed by file:type:sourceId:targetId with attributes={type} only (no line, no extra fields) so the comparison measures extraction correctness, not naming noise.
